paragraphs: I am applying for the Strategy & Operations, Insights & Analytics role on Stripe's Startup Products team. I am completing an MBA (STEM) at Fordham Gabelli after analytics and finance roles at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Atlas sits at the moment a founder decides to start a company, and the chance to explain how startups are being built on Stripe, both to the team and to the market, is the kind of analytics work I want to do.

Two pieces of my experience map closely to this role. At JPMorgan Asset Management I built cross-platform analytics frameworks and KPI metrics that drove a 135% increase in engagements while cutting media spend by up to 83%, and I synthesized large datasets into executive-level dashboards and narratives for senior leadership. At Lenovo I designed and deployed AI-powered dashboards that automated reporting and saved 4+ hours a week, and defined segmentation strategies that improved campaign ROI by 20%.

That combination of owning metrics, running deep dives that explain what changed and why, and packaging the answer clearly for stakeholders is what your team describes. I would bring the same rigor to understanding founders and shaping Startup Products priorities, and I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute.
